usedFor: SuperPhone holds contacts and Google Docs holds the write-up, so “New Contact” can feed “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in SuperPhone, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new contact adds text to the chosen tab, so the doc stays current.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so set it to add text.
